  valid JSON, consecutive step_no from 1, allowed operation/state pairs,

  []. Otherwise, emit INCOMPLETE with [].

  dataset/sample_deletion_requests.csv and compare with
  dataset/sample_output.csv. Report: status accuracy; step-level
  precision/recall/F1 on exact tuples; sequence accuracy; and a compact diff
  for failures.
